subject.title: fix(whatsapp): preserve inbound messages across restarts

question: Should the durable-ingress contract gain a persisted ordering key for same-lane equal-millisecond events, or should WhatsApp supply a monotonic queue-level receive timestamp without changing the shared queue schema?
rationale: The current payload-only `receiveOrder` cannot affect queue claiming; choosing the durable ordering boundary affects shared persisted ingress behavior and may require a storage-contract change.

options.title: Add a shared persisted ordering key
options.body: Extend the ingress queue’s claim ordering with a durable enqueue sequence and cover restart replay for equal timestamps.

options.title: Use a plugin-provided monotonic queue timestamp
options.body: Keep the shared schema unchanged only if WhatsApp can provide a durable queue-level timestamp that remains strictly ordered across the relevant replay boundary.

recommendation.title: Add a shared persisted ordering key
recommendation.body: Extend the ingress queue’s claim ordering with a durable enqueue sequence and cover restart replay for equal timestamps.

likelyOwner.reason: The durable-ingress design and remaining-channel adapter plan originate from this feature area.
